text:
pagerbot: [ALERT] PagerDuty: Triggered page for service 'inference-prod' (service_id: svc-46b) - urgency: high - incident: INC123456 - link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC123456 :rotating_light:

jen: ugh seeing a flood of pages to inference-prod but our oncall is infra-sre not inference-team? anyone else?

omar: I got paged too, but my PD routing shows service bound to ops-sre. Is that expected?

beth: I think the PD tag 'default-service' got applied to an alert rule in prometheus. possible rule change in last deploy.

leo: Confirming — alert rule Alert:HighTokenLatency is sending to service svc-46b, but the alert intended service is inference-routing (svc-77c).

jen: Paging pd-admins to check service binding. @pagerbot show service bindings for rule Alert:HighTokenLatency

pagerbot: command accepted: `pd rules show --name "Alert:HighTokenLatency" --output json`

sre-bot: (automated) logs from last 10m: 429 errors up 320% on gpu-router-01; token latency spikes around 22:08 UTC

omar: mitigation: can someone mute alert rule or set routing override to inference-routing? I can do a quick suppress if someone confirms.

beth: Don't mute globally — that would hide real hits. Do a temporary override binding to correct service.

leo: PD CLI to rebind: `pd service-binding update --rule "Alert:HighTokenLatency" --service svc-77c --confirm` — need pd-admin perms

jen: @alex PD-admins are out of office. @beth can you do the rebind? otherwise we'll create a manual routing-rule in PD to forward pages.

beth: On it. Doing rebind now.

pagerbot: (audit) service-binding update requested by beth at 1779865448

beth: done. binding moved to svc-77c. Sending test alert.

pagerbot: test alert fired to svc-77c — INC123457 — ack pending

omar: nice, got the test. Can we de-duplicate the active INC123456 that already paged the wrong roster?

jen: Closing INC123456 via PD UI (it was noisy and targeted contractors). Also adding a note about rule templating bug.

jen: quick note — impact: ~20 pages to ops-sre and 5 contractors, no customer-facing outage detected (latency spikes but downstream retries masked errors).

leo: root cause seems to be a config template that uses tag `default-service` when team field absent. recent alert-schema change removed team field for some alerts.

beth: action items: 1) patch alert-schema to require team, 2) add unit test to alert-builder, 3) PD: add validation for service binding on deploy. I'll open tickets.

omar: oncall handoff: leaving for night shift in 30m, putting note in PD and adding playbook link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/.../playbooks/alert-routing

jen: thanks all. I'll run a postmortem doc later and tag infra and oncall leads. :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: (automated) Incident INC123456: resolved at 1779865523 by jen

beth: can we also add a canary to the alert-builder CI to catch missing fields? I'll add to PR.

jen: ack received. tagging for follow-up: #postmortem, #eng-infra, #product-alerting

pagerbot: (reminder) Next oncall for inference-team: @omar starting 1779869000

leo: closing thread, will follow up in postmortem.
